topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: Finding that hidden room, it was like uncovering a secret I wasn't sure I wanted to know. The walls held stories, and the air was thick with silence, as if the room itself was holding its breath, waiting to see what I would do. I didn't tell the real estate agent or my neighbors; something about it felt too intimate, too much mine to share just yet. I've been going over everything I know about the house, the previous owners, wondering what else I missed, what else might be left behind, hidden away. Maybe I should have looked closer, asked more questions. But it's done now, and I have this space, this secret, and I'm not sure how to carry it.
